αἰετὸς: ἀετός — eagle; masc. nom. sg., epic αἰετός (= Attic ἀετός)
αὐέρυον: αὐερύω — draw back, pull back (αὖ + ἐρύω); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
αὐτοσχεδίην: αὐτοσχέδιος — at close quarters, hand to hand; fem. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’in close combat’
αὐτὰ: αὐτός — self, same; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with κέλευθα: ’the very same’
γιγνώσκετε: γιγνώσκω — know, recognise, perceive; pres. 2 pl. indic.: ’you know’
δίεσθαι: δίεμαι — drive away, chase; pres. inf. mid., epic (cf. Attic διώκειν)
δείδοικας: δείδω — fear, dread; perf. 2 sg. with present force, epic (= Attic δέδοικας): ’you fear’
δεξί: δεξιός — on the right; neut. acc. pl., elided (δεξί’ = δεξιά), used adverbially: ’to the right’
εἰδείη: οἶδα — know; perf. opt. 3 sg. (εἰδείη), in a relative clause of characteristic: ’might know’
εἴξωσι: εἴκω — yield, give way; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., in a future condition: ’give way’
ζόφον: ζόφος — gloom, darkness (esp. of the west, where the sun sets); masc. acc. sg.
θέλγε: θέλγω — charm, enchant, beguile; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθελγε): ’was enchanting’
θεοπρόπος: θεοπρόπος — seer, prophet (one who declares the god’s will); masc. nom. sg.
θύελλαν: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall; fem. acc. sg.
κάββαλ: καταβάλλω — throw down, let fall; aor. 3 sg. in tmesis: κάββαλ’ = κατὰ βάλε run together (κατά assimilated before β), unaugmented, elided
καταλείψομεν: καταλείπω — leave behind; fut. 1 pl. act.: ’we shall leave behind’
κελευτιόωντ: κελευτιάω — give orders, urge on (from κελεύω); pres. part. masc. nom. dual, elided, epic -ιόωντε (= Attic κελευτιῶντε)
κλάγξας: κλάζω — screech, shriek, cry out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having screamed’
κονίην: κονία — dust; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η for Attic α (= Attic κονίαν)
κρόσσας: κρόσσαι — stepped ledges or battlements of a wall-tower (exact sense uncertain); fem. acc. pl.
κτεινώμεθα: κτείνω — kill; pass. be killed; pres. subj. 1 pl. pass./mid., in a concession: ’(even if) we are killed’
κόσμῳ: κόσμος — order, good order; masc. dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’in order’
λήθετο: λανθάνω (mid. λήθομαι) — forget (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐλήθετο): ’was forgetting, forgot’
λαθέσθαι: λανθάνω (mid. λήθομαι) — forget (+ gen.); aor. mid. inf.: ’to forget’
μένωνα: Μένων — Menon, a warrior slain at the wall; masc. acc. sg.
μαχήμων: μαχήμων — warlike, eager for battle; fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.), agreeing with κραδίη
μεμαῶσιν: μέμονα — be eager, be set on; perf. part. (present sense) masc. dat. pl. μεμαῶσι(ν): ’eager’
μενεδήϊος: μενεδήϊος — standing firm against the enemy (μένω + δήϊος ’hostile’); fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.), agreeing with κραδίη
μερμήριζον: μερμηρίζω — ponder, be in doubt, debate with oneself; impf. 3 pl.
μεσήεις: μεσήεις — middling, of middle rank; masc. nom. sg.
μετατρέπομ: μετατρέπομαι — turn oneself to, pay heed to (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg. mid., elided μετατρέπομ’ = μετατρέπομαι, usually with a negative
νείκεον: νεικέω — rebuke, revile, quarrel with; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.), epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐνείκουν)
οἰωνοῖσι: οἰωνός — bird (esp. a bird of omen); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
οἰωνὸς: οἰωνός — bird of omen, omen; masc. nom. sg.
πέλωρον: πέλωρ — monster, portent; neut. acc. sg., a noun in apposition to a masc. noun (the adjective πέλωρος ’monstrous’ would be masc. here)
πέτετο: πέτομαι — fly; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’was flying, flew’
παρφάμενος: πάρφημι (παράφημι) — talk over, win over with words; aor. part. mid., syncopated (= παραφάμενος), masc. nom. sg.
πειθοίατο: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= Attic -οιντο): ’might obey’
πειρήτιζον: πειρητίζω — try, make trial of, attempt; impf. 3 pl., epic by-form of πειράω; + inf.: ’were trying to’
περησέμεναι: περάω — pass over, cross, pass through; fut. inf. act., epic -μεναι (= Attic περάσειν): ’to cross’
πνοιῇς: πνοιή — breath, blast; fem. dat. pl., Ionic η for Attic α (= Attic πνοαῖς)
πουλυδάμα: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, Hector’s Trojan counsellor; masc. voc. sg., epic πουλυ- (= Attic Πολυδάμα)
προβλῆτας: προβλής — jutting out, projecting; fem. acc. pl. (two-ending adj.), agreeing with στήλας
πρώτας: πρῶτος — first, foremost; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with στήλας: ’the first (laid)’
πύλωνα: Πύλων — Pylon, a warrior slain at the wall; masc. acc. sg.
στήλας: στήλη — upright block, pillar, post; fem. acc. pl.
στερεοῖς: στερεός — firm, hard, stiff; neut. dat. pl., agreeing with ἐπέεσσι: ’hard’
τανυπτερύγεσσι: τανυπτέρυξ — long-winged, with outspread wings; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -ξι), agreeing with οἰωνοῖσι
τεράων: τέρας — sign, portent, marvel; neut. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic τεράτων)
τετράφθω: τρέπω — turn; perf. imper. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’let him be turned’, i.e. ’let him turn back’
τεῖχός: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
φέρεν: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε): ’was bringing’
φοινήεντα: φοινήεις — blood-red, bloody; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δράκοντα
φοιτήτην: φοιτάω — go to and fro, range about; impf. 3 dual, epic -ήτην (= Attic ἐφοιτάτην): ’the two went to and fro’
φράξαντες: φράσσω — fence in, cover over, protect; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having covered’
φραζομένῳ: φράζομαι — consider, plan, ponder; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’(me) planning’
χαλκοπαρῄου: χαλκοπάρῃος — bronze-cheeked; fem. gen. sg. (two-ending adj.), agreeing with κυνέης
χερειότερος: χερείων — worse, inferior; masc. nom. sg., comparative with extended ending -ότερος (= Attic χείρων)
ἀέξειν: ἀέξω — increase, make grow, strengthen; pres. inf. act.: ’to increase’
ἀγορῇσιν: ἀγορή — assembly, public meeting; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἀγοραῖς)
ἀεὶ: ἀεί — always, ever; adv. (epic also αἰεί)
ἀντιφάτην: Ἀντιφάτης — Antiphates, a warrior slain at the wall; masc. acc. sg.
ἀποτρέψεις: ἀποτρέπω — turn away, turn back (+ gen. ’from’); fut. 2 sg. act.: ’you will turn away’
ἀπωσαμένους: ἀπωθέω — push away, thrust back; aor. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.: ’having thrust back’
ἀσπαίροντα: ἀσπαίρω — gasp, quiver, struggle; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
ἀφέηκε: ἀφίημι — let go, release; aor. 3 sg., epic ἀφέηκε (= Attic ἀφῆκε): ’let go’
ἀφέξεαι: ἀπέχω (mid. ἀπέχομαι) — hold off from, abstain from (+ gen.); fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀφέξῃ)
ἅπασι: ἅπας — all, every one, the whole; masc. dat. pl.
ἐέργων: εἴργω — shut in, hem in, keep back; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐέργω (= Attic εἴργω)
ἐλευσόμεθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; fut. 1 pl. mid. (ἐλεύσομαι), elided: ’we shall go’
ἐμόχλεον: μοχλέω — pry up, lever up; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐμόχλουν)
ἐνιπρήσειν: ἐμπίμπρημι (ἐνιπίμπρημι) — set on fire, burn; fut. inf. act. (ἐνιπρήσω): ’to burn’
ἐπάλξεις: ἔπαλξις — battlement, parapet; fem. acc. pl.
ἐπιπλήσσεις: ἐπιπλήσσω — rebuke, chide, reproach; pres. 2 sg. (+ dat. of person)
ἐρρίγησαν: ῥιγέω — shudder, shiver with fear; aor. 3 pl., epic (augment with doubled ρ)
ἐτέλεσσε: τελέω — complete, accomplish, bring to pass; aor. 3 sg., epic -εσσε (= Attic ἐτέλεσε)
ἑοῖσιν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. dat. pl., agreeing with τεκέεσσιν: ’his own’
ἔλποντο: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; impf. 3 pl. mid. (deponent)
ἔρειπον: ἐρείπω — throw down, tear down, demolish; impf. 3 pl.
ἔρυον: ἐρύω — drag, pull, haul; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were dragging’
ἔσχεθεν: ἔχω — have, hold, hold back; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form ending -θε(ν) (= ἔσχε): ’held back, withstood’
ἔχματα: ἔχμα — support, prop, foundation (ἔχω ’hold’); neut. acc. pl.
ἰδνωθεὶς: ἰδνόω — bend, bow; pass. bend oneself; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having bent (back)’
ἰόντας: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’going’
ἱππόμαχον: Ἱππόμαχος — Hippomachus, son of Antimachus, slain at the wall; masc. acc. sg.
ἴδοιεν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 pl. act., in a past general clause after a relative: ’whomever they saw’
ἴωσι: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 3 pl., in an indirect alternative question after εἴτε: ’whether they go’
ἵεσθε: ἵημι (mid. ἵεμαι) — send; mid. hurry, rush, press on; pres. imper. mid. 2 pl.: ’press on!’
ὀλέσσεις: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; fut. 2 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀλεῖς): ’you will lose’
ὀτρύνοντες: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ὁμοκλητῆρος: ὁμοκλητήρ — one who calls out sharply, a rebuker or urger (ὁμοκλέω); masc. gen. sg., object of ἀκούσας
ὄπαζε: ὀπάζω — grant, bestow, give as a companion; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπόπαζε): ’kept granting’
ὄφιν: ὄφις — snake, serpent; masc. acc. sg.
ὑποκρίναιτο: ὑποκρίνομαι — answer, interpret (of a sign); aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would interpret’
ῥήγνυσθαι: ῥήγνυμι — break, break through; pres. inf. mid./pass.: ’to break through’
ῥηξόμεθα: ῥήγνυμι — break, break through; fut. 1 pl. mid., ’we shall break through’ (the wall, for ourselves)
ῥινοῖσι: ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ῥῆξ: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst through; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided ῥῆξ’ = ῥῆξε (= Attic ἔρρηξε)

__broaden__.δάμασον: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — subdue, tame, master; aor. imper. 2 sg. · also Δάμασος — Damasus, a warrior slain at the wall; masc. acc. sg.
__broaden__.διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’) · also adv. ’right through’ before πρό (διὰ πρό)
__broaden__.μέσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle of; masc. dat. sg. used as a noun: ἐν μέσῳ ’in the middle, in the midst’ · also adj. agreeing with a noun: ’in the middle of’ (μέσῳ ἐνὶ ὁμίλῳ ’in the midst of the throng’)
__broaden__.τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. τοί (= Attic οἱ), used as a relative: ’who’ · also τοί = τοι, encl. dat. of σύ: ’to you’ (κασίγνητος δέ τοί εἰμι ’I am your brother’) · also masc. nom. pl. demonstrative, with γε: ’they’
__broaden__.φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’dear’ (φίλα τέκνα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as adverb: φίλα φρονέων ’kindly disposed’ · also neut. nom. pl., attributive: ’own, dear’ (φίλα γούνατα ’my own knees’) · also neut. acc. pl., predicate: ’dear, pleasing’ (φίλα ἀγορεύεις ’say pleasing things’)
__broaden__.ἀγορευέμεν: ἀγορεύω — speak, tell; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic -εύειν), used as an imperative: ’tell!’ · also plain inf. after ἔοικε: ’to speak’
__broaden__.ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες) · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’men!’
__broaden__.ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg. · also ἄλλον … ἄλλον, correlative: ’one … another’
